content:
The investigation traced the flow of INR 4,70,000 originating from seed wallet 0xa7f39c1d8e4b2a5f7c3d9e0a1b8c6d4e5f2a67e9 on 8 September 2026 at 10:31 IST. Within three hops, 14 distinct entities were involved in 17 transfers, of which 16 are confirmed and one is inferred. The seed address carries a high risk score of 65/100, reflecting proximity to a known scam cluster, rapid automated dispersal (first outbound three minutes after receipt), interaction with a mixer contract (transfer of 1,500 USDT to 0x8589f2c47b1d0a63e95482f7ca1b3d6e0f4a0b6f), and exposure to a cross‑chain bridge within two downstream hops. Sixteen transfers meet or exceed the 30 % reporting threshold, while one falls below it.

Among the entities, address 0x9c04a7e3b21d5f86c0a94e7d2b83f150c6ead21e registers the highest risk score of 75/100 (critical), followed by the seed wallet at 65/100 (high) and address 0x3f1a7d92c04e8b56af10d3e7b829c45d6e0a71bc at 35/100 (medium). No individual has been identified as the account holder.
